units.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Java reads .obj and .stl files and writes .stl files. It constructs scene graphs using Scene, Node, and Entity classes, supports primitive mesh geometry such as Box, Cylinder, Sphere, and Dish, and defines PBR materials. It also provides NURBS curve control-point and knot data, and vector, matrix, and quaternion math operations. The project is licensed under the MIT License.
Build and traverse 3D scene graphs using Scene, Node, and Entity classes, attaching geometry through Node.addEntity or Node.createChildNode and organizing nodes into a parent-child hierarchy.
Import and export STL geometry in binary or ASCII format using StlLoadOptions and StlSaveOptions, dispatched through Scene.fromFile and Scene.save, with the .stl format fully functional end to end.

Define materials with LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, and PbrMaterial classes supporting albedo, metallic/roughness, occlusion, and emissive channels plus texture references, and assign them per node via Node.setMaterial.
Model NURBS curves using NurbsCurve, exposing control points, knot vectors, and degree/order data.
Perform 3D math operations using Vector2, Vector3, Vector4, Matrix4, Quaternion, and BoundingBox classes that underlie every scene operation.
Detect file format automatically or resolve an explicit format from a file path or binary stream using FileFormat.detect and FileFormat.getFormatByExtension.
This example creates a 2.0 unit cube and saves it as an STL file named box.stl.
The following examples demonstrate common workflows using the library's scene-graph and geometry APIs.
Create a NURBS curve and define its control points.

The Scene class serves as the primary entry point, with Scene.fromFile and Scene.fromStream loading geometry using automatic format detection, getRootNode exposing the scene graph, and Scene.save writing it back out. The com.aspose.threed package contains the full public API surface for 3D operations.
The com package namespace hosts the top-level public API for Aspose.3D FOSS for Java, with com.aspose and com.aspose.threed forming the core hierarchy.
The com.aspose namespace provides shared infrastructure and base types used across the 3D API, including core interfaces, enumerations, and utility classes that support 3D scene operations.
The com.aspose.threed namespace contains the 3D-specific classes such as Scene, Node, Mesh, Material, and PbrMaterial that enable loading, manipulating, and saving 3D scenes.

It adds broader format support (including glTF, FBX, USD, PDF, A3DW, and JT), full mesh conversion for every primitive, NURBS curve evaluation, rendering, and additional API surface — simply swap to the commercial package; no separate trial download is required.
A3DObject class provides a base object with a name property and a properties collection, supporting property lookup, retrieval, and removal.
AnimationClip class represents an animation clip with a name property and a properties collection, supporting property lookup, retrieval, and removal.
ArrayListAdapter class provides an adapter for a list with methods to add, remove, and access elements, check for containment, and determine size and emptiness.
AssetInfo class holds metadata about a 3D asset, including application name, version, author, comments, copyright, creation date, keywords, name, revision, subject, and title.
Axis enum lists the X_AXIS, Y_AXIS, Z_AXIS, NEGATIVE_X_AXIS, NEGATIVE_Y_AXIS, and NEGATIVE_Z_AXIS axis constants.
AxisSystem class defines an axis system with a coordinate system, front direction, and up direction, supporting transformation to another axis system and creation from asset info.
Camera class represents a camera with an aspect ratio, direction, and far plane distance, and a moveForward member that is not implemented.
Cancellation class provides a mechanism to signal cancellation with methods to cancel and check cancellation status.

ColladaSaveOptions class provides options for saving Collada files with encoding, exportTextures, fileName, fileSystem, and fileSystemFactory properties, where exportTextures and fileSystemFactory always return false and null respectively.
ColladaTransformStyle enum lists the Components and Matrix transform style constants.
CoordinateSystem enum lists the LEFT_HANDED and RIGHT_HANDED coordinate system constants.
CubeFace enum lists the POSITIVEX, NEGATIVEX, POSITIVEY, NEGATIVEY, POSITIVEZ, and NEGATIVEZ cube face constants.
CustomObject class provides a base object with a name property and a properties collection, supporting property lookup, retrieval, and removal.
Deformer class represents a deformer with an owner property referencing the geometry that owns it, and a name property and properties collection.
DrawOperation enum lists the LINES, LINE_STRIP, POINTS, TRIANGLES, TRIANGLE_FAN, and TRIANGLE_STRIP draw operation constants, and its valueOf method throws IllegalArgumentException conditionally.
DummyFileSystem class provides dummy file system operations with methods to create dummy, local, memory, and zip file systems, and to read and write files.
Entity class represents an entity with a bounding box, entity renderer key, and excluded flag, and supports property lookup and retrieval.
ExportException class represents an exception thrown during export operations.
FMatrix4 class represents a 4x4 matrix with identity and methods to clone, concatenate, copy from, compare, and hash, where clone throws RuntimeException conditionally.
FVector2 class represents a 2D float vector with methods to add, clone, compare, copy from, create, compare, and hash, where clone throws RuntimeException conditionally.

FVector3 class represents a 3D float vector with methods to add, clone, compare, copy from, create, cross, and divide, where clone throws RuntimeException conditionally, get throws IndexOutOfBoundsException conditionally, and set throws IndexOutOfBoundsException conditionally.
FVector4 class represents a 4D float vector with a constructor.
FileContentType enum lists the ASCII and BINARY file content type constants.

FileFormat class represents file formats with fields for AMF, ASE, ASPOSE3D_WEB, BLENDER, COLLADA, DISCREET3DS, DRACO, and DXF, where canDetect always returns false, createLoadOptions throws ImportException conditionally, and createSaveOptions throws UnsupportedOperationException conditionally.
FileFormatType class represents file format types with fields for AMF, ASE, ASPOSE3D_WEB, BLENDER, COLLADA, DISCREET3DS, DRACO, and DXF.
Geometry class represents a geometry with a bounding box, cast shadows flag, control points, and methods to add a deformer, add an element, create an element, and create a UV element.
IBuffer interface represents a buffer.
IDescriptorSet interface represents a descriptor set.
IIndexBuffer interface represents an index buffer.
IMeshConvertible interface represents an object that can be converted to a mesh with a toMesh method.
INamedObject interface represents an object with a name property and methods to get and set the name.
IPipeline interface represents a pipeline.
IRenderQueue interface represents a render queue.
IRenderTarget interface represents a render target.
IRenderTexture interface represents a render texture.
IRenderWindow interface represents a render window.
ITextureUnit interface represents a texture unit.
IVertexBuffer interface represents a vertex buffer.

ImageRenderOptions class provides options for rendering images with assetDirectories, backgroundColor, enableShadows, encoding, exportTextures, fileName, and fileSystem properties, where exportTextures and fileSystemFactory always return false and null respectively.
ImportException class represents an exception thrown during import operations.
IndexDataType enum lists the INT16 and INT32 index data types.
Interpolation enum lists the BEZIER, B_SPLINE, CARDINAL_SPLINE, CONSTANT, LINEAR, and TCB_SPLINE interpolation types.
KeyFrame class holds animation keyframe data with properties such as time, value, interpolation, tension, continuity, flat, bias, stepMode, tangentWeightMode, and tangents.
Light class represents a light entity with properties such as color, enabled state, falloff start and end, bounding box, excluded flag, and entity renderer key.
LightType enum lists the AREA, DIRECTIONAL, ENVIRONMENT, POINT, and SPOT light types.
LocalFileSystem class provides file system operations including creating dummy, local, memory, and zip file systems, and reading and writing files.
MappingMode enum lists the ALL_SAME, CONTROL_POINT, POLYGON, and POLYGON_VERTEX mapping modes.
Matrix4 class represents a 4x4 matrix with methods for decomposition, concatenation, cloning, copying, and determinant calculation.
MemoryFileSystem class provides file system operations including creating dummy, local, memory, and zip file systems, and reading and writing files.
Mesh class represents a mesh geometry with control points, bounding box, deformer support, and rendering properties.
Microsoft3MFSaveOptions class holds export options for Microsoft 3MF format including encoding, file name, file system, export textures, and file system factory.
Node class represents a node in the scene hierarchy with child nodes, entities, bounding box, and asset information.
NurbsCurve class represents a NURBS curve with control points, color, curve type, degree, and dimension; the evaluate and evaluateAt methods are not implemented.
NurbsDirection class holds NURBS direction data with properties such as degree, count, divisions, knot vectors, and multiplicities.
ObjLoadOptions class holds import options for OBJ format including encoding, file name, file system, file system factory, enable materials, and coordinate system flipping.
ObjSaveOptions class holds export options for OBJ format including encoding, file name, file system, export textures, axis system, apply unit scale, and enable materials.
ParseException class represents an exception thrown during parsing operations.
PlyLoadOptions class holds import options for PLY format including encoding, file name, file system, and file system factory.
PlySaveOptions class holds export options for PLY format including encoding, file name, file system, export textures, and file system factory.
PresetShaders enum lists the CUSTOMIZED and DEFAULT shader presets.
PropertyCollection class provides methods to add, find, get, remove, set, and iterate over properties.
Quaternion class represents a quaternion with methods for conjugation, multiplication, normalization, and conversion from angle-axis or Euler angles.
ReferenceMode enum lists the DIRECT, INDEX, and INDEX_TO_DIRECT reference modes.
RenderFactory class provides methods to create render resources such as render textures, descriptor sets, index buffers, pipelines, render windows, shader programs, and texture units.
RenderParameters class holds parameters for rendering operations.
RenderQueueGroupId class identifies groups in the render queue.
RenderResource class represents a base class for render resources.
RenderStage class represents a rendering stage.
RenderState class represents a rendering state.
Renderer class represents a renderer for rendering operations.
RendererException class represents an exception thrown during rendering operations.
RendererVariableManager class manages variables for the renderer.

Scene class represents a 3D scene with animation clips, asset information, and methods to clear, create animation clips, and find properties; the render method is not implemented and the save method may throw IOException.
SceneObject class represents an object in the scene with a name, properties, and a reference to its parent scene.
ShaderProgram class represents a shader program; the close method is not implemented.
ShaderSource class represents the source of a shader.
Stream class represents a stream with methods to close, flush, copy to another stream, get input stream, and get length; it supports seeking from start, current, or end positions.
Struct class represents a structure with methods to clone and copy from another instance.
TextureData class holds texture data.
TextureMapping enum lists the AMBIENT, BUMP, DIFFUSE, EMISSIVE, GLOW, NORMAL, REFLECTION, SPECULAR, and TRANSPARENCY texture mapping types.
TextureType enum lists the ARRAY2D, CUBE_MAP, TEXTURE1D, TEXTURE2D and TEXTURE3D texture type values.
Transform class holds geometric transformations with properties for eulerAngles, geometricRotation, geometricScaling, geometricTranslation and methods to get and set transform components.
Vector2 class provides two-dimensional vector operations with methods for add, compareTo, cross, div, dot, equals and getLength.
Vector3 class provides three-dimensional vector operations and its get method throws IndexOutOfBoundsException conditionally.
Vector4 class provides a constructor for four-dimensional vector initialization.
Version class holds version information with properties for build, major and minor numbers and methods to get and compare version values.
VertexDeclaration class manages vertex declarations with methods to add fields and clear contents, where addField and clear throw IllegalStateException conditionally.
VertexElementBinormal class represents a binormal vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementDoublesTemplate class provides a template for double-precision vertex elements with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementEdgeCrease class represents an edge crease vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementFVector class provides a template for floating-point vector vertex elements with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementHole class represents a hole vertex element with a method to get its vertex element type.
VertexElementIntsTemplate class provides a template for integer vertex elements with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementMaterial class represents a material vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementNormal class represents a normal vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementPolygonGroup class represents a polygon group vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementSmoothingGroup class represents a smoothing group vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementSpecular class represents a specular vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementTangent class represents a tangent vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementTemplate class provides a template for vertex elements with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementType enum lists the BINORMAL, EDGE_CREASE, HOLE, MATERIAL, NORMAL, POLYGON_GROUP, SMOOTHING_GROUP, SPECULAR, TANGENT, USER_DATA, UV and VERTEX_COLOR vertex element type values.
VertexElementUV class represents a UV coordinate vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementUserData class represents user data vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementVector4 class provides a template for four-component vector vertex elements with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementVertexColor class represents a vertex color vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementVertexCrease class represents a vertex crease vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexElementVisibility class represents a visibility vertex element with a method to get its vertex element type.
VertexElementWeight class represents a weight vertex element with methods to get indices, mapping mode, name and reference mode.
VertexField class describes a vertex field with properties for alias and data type and methods to get index, offset and compare fields.
WindowHandle class provides static methods to create window handles from Wayland, Win32 and Xlib platforms.
ZipFileSystem class provides file system implementations with methods to create dummy, local, memory and zip file systems, where readFile and writeFile throw UnsupportedOperationException.
